findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pricepaid_fuel_prices_now, pricepaid_price_levels · Private data: pricepaid_childcare_prices, pricepaid_commercial_property, pricepaid_contract_prices, pricepaid_energy_prices, pricepaid_fuel_prices_now, pricepaid_fuel_price_history, pricepaid_grocery_prices, pricepaid_health_insurance_premiums, pricepaid_home_sales, pricepaid_medical_prices, pricepaid_producer_prices, pricepaid_rent_prices, pricepaid_auction_prices, pricepaid_tuition_fees, pricepaid_wholesale_market_prices, pricepaid_wholesale_power_prices, pricepaid_wholesale_power_price_history, pricepaid_check_price · Public sink: pricepaid_contract_prices, pricepaid_airfare_prices, pricepaid_home_upgrade_prices, pricepaid_medical_prices · Destructive: pricepaid_energy_prices, pricepaid_rent_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pricepaid_fuel_prices_now, pricepaid_price_levels · Private data: pricepaid_childcare_prices, pricepaid_commercial_property, pricepaid_contract_prices, pricepaid_energy_prices, pricepaid_fuel_prices_now, pricepaid_fuel_price_history, pricepaid_grocery_prices, pricepaid_health_insurance_premiums, pricepaid_home_sales, pricepaid_medical_prices, pricepaid_producer_prices, pricepaid_rent_prices, pricepaid_auction_prices, pricepaid_tuition_fees, pricepaid_wholesale_market_prices, pricepaid_wholesale_power_prices, pricepaid_wholesale_power_price_history, pricepaid_check_price · Public sink: pricepaid_contract_prices, pricepaid_airfare_prices, pricepaid_home_upgrade_prices, pricepaid_medical_prices · Destructive: pricepaid_energy_prices, pricepaid_rent_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
